title: Thin diagonal supports don't count: a cart on rails reads as floating
summary: A cart on rails 'floated 13 cm': flatThin() treats a diagonal rail's low AABB as a decal and the 8%-inset feet rays miss 5 cm rails. Rails 10 cm tall, 12 cm wide, 5 cm wheels.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: railTrack() in module.recon.mine-props is sized for this (10 x 12 cm rails); debug with ?cdebug=name (__CONTACT_DEBUG shows the gaps per foot)

doc.when: Anything resting on narrow or diagonal supports (rails, beams, pipes).
gotchas: Engine fix wanted: oriented boxes, rays from the true contact points.

problem.symptom: FLOATING ~13 cm for an object that visibly rests on rails/beams.
problem.cause: (a) flatThin() uses the AABB, so a diagonal rail is treated as a decal and ignored as support; (b) the feet rays are inset 8% toward the centre and miss narrow supports.
problem.fix: Make supports taller than 'flat' (10 cm) and wider (12 cm); narrow the wheels.
problem.detect: CDEBUG on the object: per-foot ray gaps.
